PROFESSIONAL SUMMARY 
B.Tech AI & Data Science student (CGPA: 7.9) with internship experience in full -stack MERN development and DevOps pipelines (Docker, 
Kubernetes, GitLab CI/CD, Argo CD). Built and deployed AI-powered and full-stack applications using Python, Flask, React.js, and OpenCV. Solved 
200+ problems on LeetCode (Rating: 1392). Seeking roles in Software Engineering, Full Stack, DevOps, or AI/ML development. 
TECHNICAL SKILLS 
Languages: Java | Python | C++ | C | JavaScript | HTML5 | CSS | MySQL 
Frameworks: React.js | Node.js | Express.js | Flask | Tailwind CSS | NumPy | Matplotlib 
DevOps: Docker | Docker Hub | Kubernetes (k3s) | GitLab CI/CD | GitOps 
Databases: MySQL | MongoDB | PostgreSQL 
Concepts: OOP | DSA | DBMS | Machine Learning | REST API 
Tools: VS Code | GitHub | GitLab | Postman | Jupyter Notebook 
INTERNSHIPS 
Infoziant — MERN Stack Intern 2025 
• Developed 3 responsive full-stack web applications using MongoDB, Express.js, React.js, and Node.js, integrating frontend interfaces with 
backend REST APIs. Built 10+ reusable React.js components with state management and improving UI consistency 
• Designed RESTful APIs for user authentication, data exchange, and business logic; optimized MongoDB schemas for efficient CRU D 
operations. 
DevOps Intern 2026 
• Containerized applications with Docker and Docker Hub; configured Kubernetes (k3s) clusters with Deployments, Services, and N odePort 
for production orchestration. 
• Built GitLab CI/CD pipelines to automate build, test, and deploy workflows; implemented GitOps delivery via Argo CD syncing Git repos to 
Kubernetes clusters. 
PROJECTS 
Smart Attendance Tracking System for Rural Schools 2026 
Tech Stack: Python | OpenCV | LBPH Face Recognizer | Haar Cascade | Flask Live Demo 
• Built an AI-powered face recognition attendance system using OpenCV's LBPH algorithm and Haar Cascade detection, achieving reliable 
identification in low-resource rural school environments. 
• Deployed a live Flask web application on Render, processing real -time video feeds and logging attendance automatically — replacing 
manual roll calls entirely. Designed for low-bandwidth environments with minimal hardware requirements. 
MediScan AI — AI-Simulated Medical Diagnosis System 2025 
Tech Stack: Python | Flask | OpenCV | HTML | CSS | JavaScript | SQL | Computer Vision 
• Built a full-stack AI diagnostic web app using Flask and OpenCV to analyze X-ray images and deliver probabilistic disease recommendations 
via a rule-based inference engine. 
• Implemented secure patient management with authentication, SQL database integration, and a responsive multilingual dashboard for 
healthcare usability. 
ACHIEVEMENTS 
• Second Prize — Project Expo 2026, Sri Eshwar College of Engineering (SECE) 2026 
• Finalist — InnoHack 2K26, VIT Hackathon (selected among 150+ teams) 2026 
• Final Round — Smart India Hackathon (SIH) 2025 Internals 2025
